_status: Defined 2026-11-03 following the user's decision (option C, phase-0 approval). Only the user may change it.
_why: A clean 12-month holdout does not exist: 2025-10..2026-10 was already backtested by the baselines and the H-002 end-to-end run, and the validation window (2024-07..2026-10) was read once for H-008. So the last 12 months are reported as SEMI-CONTAMINATED, and the only truly unseen data is what is published after the cut-off below.

semi_contaminated_window.label: last 12 months of the historical data (semi-contaminated: already seen by earlier experiments)

prospective_holdout.label: true prospective holdout: never used for selection, parameters or thresholds
prospective_holdout.use: evaluation only; no optimisation of any kind may read it
prospective_holdout._evaluation_rule: Evaluate no earlier than earliest_evaluation_utc AND only when the strategy has at least min_closed_trades closed trades in the holdout (pooled over the tested pairs). If the trade count is lower at preferred_evaluation_utc, the evaluation is reported as inconclusive with bootstrap intervals, never as success or failure. One evaluation per frozen strategy.
prospective_holdout.unlock: lab/config/splits.json final_test.final_test_unlocked stays false until the user decides; runner.py refuses the split while it is false.
